USB Radio POC — P1

ESP32-S3: live HTTP MP3 stream exposed as a virtual read-only FAT16 USB mass-storage disk (RADIO.MP3).

Web Serial not supported: use Chrome or Edge. Serve this page over HTTPS or from localhost.
  1. Connect the board's USB-UART port to this computer, then click the button and pick the serial port.
  2. After flashing, choose Connect to Wi-Fi in the dialog (Improv Serial): pick your network and enter the password. It is saved in the board's flash; nothing is baked into the firmware. Do this with the OTG port unplugged.
  3. Use Logs & Console to watch the boot log (115200 baud).
  4. Plug the board's native USB OTG port (D+ GPIO20 / D- GPIO19) into the Metronic.
